costScopes.silver: cpuSeconds and all derived fight/forecast/decision CPU values time playoutBattle only; exclude exitBattle, RAW copy and post-callback work.
costScopes.ctmExpectation: Repeated captureCombatPredictorInput plus expectation, averaged over timing repetitions.
costScopes.ctmSample: Repeated input capture, prepare and one sample, averaged over timing repetitions; distinct from the 32 forecast draws.
costScopes.process: Runner receipt covers whole source process and all overhead. No exact end-to-end CTM/Silver CPU ratio is claimed.

limitations: Descriptive selected trajectories, at most four source clusters; no confidence intervals or winner.
Plain10k is an independent behavioral reference, not optimal play; CTM controller mismatch remains.
CTM32 and Silver4 categorical scores evaluate different finite-sample forecast sizes.
No training, OOC decision quality, public-input sufficiency, or promotion conclusion.
